name: Area 47
kurzbeschreibung: AREA 47 at the gateway to the Ötztal is Austria's largest outdoor adventure park with Water AREA, giant water slides, and adrenaline-pumping thrills.
beschreibung:
Overview

AREA 47, situated at the confluence of the Ötztaler Ache and the Inn River, is Austria's largest outdoor adventure park and one of the world's premier action and fun sports resorts. Named after its geographic location on the 47th parallel, the spectacular facility covers a sprawling area of approximately 95,000 m² (9.5 hectares). Divided into cutting-edge activity zones, the park draws adrenaline enthusiasts, active holidaymakers, families, and watersports fans from across Europe.

Action Zones & Attractions

Opened on May 21, 2010, AREA 47 continually sets new benchmarks in outdoor adventure sports. The ultimate focal point on hot summer days is the approx. 20,000 m² Water AREA: an artificial swimming lake featuring a 27-meter-high dive tower, record-breaking water slides (including free-fall slides reaching speeds of up to 80 km/h), spectacular Blobbing, the Cannonball water catapult, and an inflatable floating obstacle course (Splash Track). Right next door, the Wake AREA beckons on a dedicated 20,000 m² lake featuring a modern 420-meter 5-tower cable system and professional wakeboarding obstacles (kickers, boxes). The Climbing AREA impresses with Austria's highest artificial climbing tower, a high-ropes course suspended 27 meters above the ground beneath a motorway bridge, the Mega Swing, and a Flying Fox zip line spanning the entire grounds. Whitewater sports enthusiasts set out from here on professionally guided rafting and canyoning expeditions through the Imster Schlucht and Ötztal gorges. A 3,700 m² Indoor Bike Park allows smooth pumptrack riding in any weather.

Visit & Getting There

AREA 47 is open seasonally from early May to early October. The Water AREA welcomes visitors daily from 10:00 to 18:00 (extended to 19:00 in peak summer months July and August). Water AREA admission prices (2025/2026 season): adult day ticket €32.00 (low season) to €39.00 (high season), children (6–15 yrs) approx. €22.00 to €26.00, children under 6 free. When booking guided outdoor excursions or staying overnight in the park's tipis and wooden lodges, admission to the Water AREA is included. Wake AREA: 2-hour ticket from approx. €35.00. By car: Inntalautobahn A12, exit 123 Haiming/Ötztal, then follow signs directly at the roundabout to AREA 47 (Ötztaler Achstraße 1, Roppen); extensive parking is available on site. By public transport: take ÖBB trains to Ötztal-Bahnhof station; from there it is a 15- to 20-minute walk or a brief ride on the regional shuttle bus directly to the park entrance.

Tips

The main pathways connecting the restaurants and sunbathing lawns are paved; however, due to steep lakeside banks, wooden stairs to slide towers, and damp docks, the action zones offer only limited accessibility for wheelchair users. For visiting the Water AREA, snug-fitting swimwear is strongly advised (no loose boardshorts on slides). Wetsuits and life jackets are provided on site free of charge if required.
